pride_data.title: A membrane-permeable and IMAC-enrichable crosslinking reagent for advanced in vivo crosslinking mass spectrometry
pride_data.projectDescription: We developed a novel membrane-permeable and IMAC-enrichable cross-linker tBu-PhoX. Applying our optimized in vivo XL-MS pipeline, we revealed PPI landscape from intact human cells.
pride_data.sampleProcessingProtocol: HEK293T cells, E. coli and B. subtilis were harvested and re-suspended in Phosphate-buffered saline (PBS). Samples were washed 3 times with PBS to exclude amine-contained medium. Intact mitochondria were harvested and purified from mouse heart, then washed 3 times with 300 mM Trehalose buffer. Protein concentration was adjusted to 10 mg/ml. Cells or intact mitochondria crosslinking was performed twice, each time with 1 mM tBu-PhoX for 30 min at room temperature. Crosslinking reaction was quenched with 30 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 for 15 min at room temperature. Crosslinked sample is lysed by SDS-based lysis buffer, followed by protein precipitation. After tryptic digestion and cleaned by C8 StageTip, precleaning step is performed. Then, phosphonate is denuded by deprotection, followed by phosphoenrichment to LC-MS.
pride_data.dataProcessingProtocol: Raw data were searched by Plink2 with 1% FDR criteria. All the comparison is finished by R. 3D structure is displayed by pymol and python script.
